description: Returns a model's price over time. Each point is [date, amount] with the date as YYYY-MM-DD. The series holds only the points where the price CHANGED — prices are step functions, so a stable model is one point, not one per day; when a price changed twice on one day, both points are returned with the same date, in order. One series per price dimension: two dimensions can share a label, so the ones that would collide carry their qualifiers, e.g. 'Web search (context size: high)'.
name: price_history
title: Price history
